text:
elena: Putting together the relnotes + changelog entry for the Routing v2 rollout and the Dedicated migration guidance. Draft here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4389
barry: skimmed. strong. two things I think we should add: (1) an explicit "how to pin model variant" snippet for Dedicated customers, (2) a short troubleshooting subsection for when clients see higher cold-start latencies after cache resets
elena: added the pinning snippet and a 1-paragraph troubleshooting note. PTAL. I also called out that when routing falls back to a quantized variant, expect minor output variation and suggested an eval checklist
nate: small code nit: Go SDK example still uses Client.GenerateText — new API is client.Text.Generate. can someone update the sample?
elena: updated Go + Python + JS samples to new SDK shapes. left an inline note showing both legacy and new forms for quick reference
docs-bot: snippet-linter: 3 warnings in examples/routing-warmup.md: line 12 long line; line 34 using deprecated param `preset`; line 58 missing language tag for fenced block
elena: fixed lints and pushed. removed `preset` param, replaced with `profile` in examples
link-bot: linkcheck: /guides/dedicated/migration#old-pin-guide -> 404. Suggest replace with /guides/dedicated/migration#pin-variant
elena: fixed the link and added a redirect note in the migration checklist
barry: propose we include rollout cadence in the relnotes so SEs and PMs can coordinate: canary 5% for 3h, 25% for 12h, 75% for 24h with automated rollback on error-rate or latency SLOs
elena: added rollout cadence and an ops playbook snippet for rollback triggers (http thresholds + model-quality alert). Also added a "what to expect" short blurb: small latency variance during prefix cache warming; token counting for streaming embeddings may be off by 1 token on some legacy models
nate: add a quick warmup curl example to the migration doc so customers can pre-warm their prefix caches if switching variants. something like: ```bash
# pre-warm prefix cache for kestrel-13b
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" \
  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/text.generate \
  -d '{"model":"kestrel-13b","input":"Warmup request: please cache this prefix"}'
```
elena: good idea. added warmup sample and a note about rate limits when doing large-scale warmups (recommend 10 RPS per GPU).
docs-bot: deploy-preview: preview link generated: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/4389/relnotes-routing-v2
link-bot: linkcheck: all links OK in preview build except external: https://thirdparty.example.com/quant-compat -> 410 (archived). Marked as advisory note instead of link
barry: one more: add a short "migration checklist" table for Dedicated onboarding (steps: pin variant, warm cache, run eval prompts, monitor quality & latency) - helps support handoffs
elena: added checklist bullets and a tiny script in misc/warmup-scripts.sh reference. also drafted the changelog bullet: "Routing v2: adaptive routing, variant pinning, and graceful quantized fallbacks (see docs for caveats)"
nate: LGTM. :thumbsup:
docs-bot: all checks passing. ready for merge.
elena: planning to merge in 15m and schedule publish 08:30 UTC. I'll post to #announcements and #support when live with the short summary and links to the migration checklist. Thanks team!
